verdict.rationale: Appwrite Functions support scheduled executions alongside HTTP/event/webhook triggers, directly enabling recurring jobs, and Messaging can schedule notifications too. However, evidence is limited to a brief docs mention with no detail on cron syntax, workflow chaining, retries, or orchestration of multi-step workflows. Missing for 10: detailed docs/examples on cron scheduling syntax, workflow/orchestration support beyond single function triggers, independent hands-on confirmation of scheduling reliability.
